content.text:
I'm requesting documents for case B-015 because the entity's registry filing is out of date. Everything else in the file meets the SOP.

**Why documents are needed (3.5):** The registry filing is dated 2025-11-15. On the review date of 2026-10-27 it is about 11 months old, and the SOP requires it to be less than 6 months old.

**What passes:**
- **Control person (3.2):** Yusuf Ishikawa, the CEO.
- **Ownership (3.3):** The shares add up to 100%, so nothing is unaccounted for. Nimbus Holdings LLC holds 21% and is wholly owned by Ivan Petrov, so he owns 21% indirectly. Ishikawa (41%) and Nora Silva (29%) are the only people at 25% or more. Nobody unidentified could reach 25%, so ownership is complete.
- **Identity checks (3.4):** All four people named in the file have verified IDs.
- **Screening (Section 4):** No sanctions matches, politically exposed persons or adverse media on the entity or any of the four.
- **Industry and geography (Sections 5 and 6):** The industry is normal, and the entity and all four people are in the US.

**Gap to fix before approval:** The adverse media results say "no", but there is no record of the searches (terms, date and sources), which 4.4 requires. On its own that would make the case incomplete. Because requesting documents ranks higher under 2.1, it doesn't change today's outcome, but the search records will be needed before the case can be approved.
